ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #14 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the name of the Arabic letter ت? (1 mark)
   A. Saad
   B. Haa
   C. daal
   D. taa

2. What is the name of the Arabic letter ض? (1 mark)
   A. taa
   B. Daad
   C. thaa
   D. ghayn

3. How many letters are in the Arabic alphabet? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 28
   C. 30
   D. 26

4. Which sound does the Arabic letter ش make? (1 mark)
   A. k as in kite
   B. kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
   C. sh as in shop
   D. t as in tap

5. How do you read the syllable تُ? (1 mark)
   A. bu
   B. nii
   C. tu
   D. thaa

6. What does the Arabic sentence مَرْحَبًا يَا أَحْمَدُ mean? (1 mark)
   A. My brother is small.
   B. My grandfather is old (big in age).
   C. My sister is beautiful.
   D. Hello, Ahmad.

7. What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ وَكُرْسِيٌّ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The house is big.
   B. On the table there is a cup.
   C. In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
   D. This is my room.

8. What does the Arabic sentence الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. How are you? (to a girl)
   B. On the table there is a cup.
   C. In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
   D. The house is big.

9. Which Arabic sentence means "I visit my grandmother on Friday." (1 mark)
   A. أَقْرَأُ كِتَابًا يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ
   B. أَنَا مِنْ كينيا
   C. أُسَاعِدُ أُمِّي يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ
   D. أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ

10. How is the Arabic word الْجُمُعَةُ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. al-ithnayn
   B. usbuuʿ
   C. al-yawm
   D. al-jumuʿa

11. How is the Arabic word نَعَمْ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. hafla
   B. baaluun
   C. naʿam
   D. mabruuk

12. Which Arabic word means "please, go ahead"? (1 mark)
   A. تَفَضَّلْ
   B. عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ
   C. لَا
   D. شَمْعَةٌ

13. How is the Arabic word طَمَاطِمُ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. faakiha
   B. samak
   C. shaay
   D. tamaatim

14. How is the Arabic word سُكَّرٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. sukkar
   B. lahm
   C. burtuqaal
   D. jazar

15. What is a reader's theatre? (1 mark)
   A. A spelling test
   B. A drawing competition
   C. A group reads a script aloud with expression
   D. A silent reading time

16. Which Arabic sentence means "My body is strong." (1 mark)
   A. هَذَا جِسْمِي
   B. لِي يَدَانِ
   C. لِي عَيْنَانِ
   D. جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ

17. How is the Arabic word جَبَلٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. jabal
   B. nahr
   C. riih
   D. shams

18. What does the word min mean in maTaru mina s-samaa'i? (1 mark)
   A. from
   B. and
   C. in
   D. on

19. Which Arabic sentence means "The chair is at the door." (1 mark)
   A. الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ
   B. الْمِفْتَاحُ فِي الْخِزَانَةِ
   C. لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ
   D. أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي

20. What does the Arabic sentence الْمِفْتَاحُ فِي الْخِزَانَةِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The chair is at the door.
   B. I read a book on Sunday.
   C. The key is in the cupboard.
   D. Do not play with the knife.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Sort these words into items and position words: kitaab, ʿalaa, taawila, taHta. (4 marks) (4 marks)

22. Translate into English: wal-maTaru mina s-samaa'i (2 marks)

23. Translate into English: aktubu bi-yadii. asmaʿu bi-udhunii. (2 marks) (2 marks)

24. Translate into English: as-samaku ladhiidh (2 marks)

25. Translate into English: haadhaa jismii (2 marks)

26. Name the four marks (harakat) that show short vowels or no vowel and say what each one shows. (4 marks) (4 marks)

27. Write five household items in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

28. Describe how a group can stage a poem at an interclass festival. (4 marks) (4 marks)

29. Give three points you would check when you assess a friend's reading. (3 marks) (3 marks)

30. Translate into English: haadhihi hafla (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #14 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — taa
   The letter ت is called taa.

2. B — Daad
   The letter ض is called Daad.

3. B — 28
   The Arabic alphabet has 28 letters.

4. C — sh as in shop
   The letter ش makes the sound sh as in shop.

5. C — tu
   تُ is read tu.

6. D — Hello, Ahmad.
   مَرْحَبًا يَا أَحْمَدُ (marhaban yaa Ahmad) means: Hello, Ahmad.

7. C — In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
   فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ وَكُرْسِيٌّ (fii l-matbakhi taawila wa kursii) means: In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.

8. D — The house is big.
   الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ (al-baytu kabiir) means: The house is big.

9. D — أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
   أَزُورُ جَدَّتِي يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ (azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa) means: I visit my grandmother on Friday.

10. D — al-jumuʿa
   الْجُمُعَةُ is read al-jumuʿa and means Friday.

11. C — naʿam
   نَعَمْ is read naʿam and means yes.

12. A — تَفَضَّلْ
   تَفَضَّلْ (tafaddal) means please, go ahead.

13. D — tamaatim
   طَمَاطِمُ is read tamaatim and means tomatoes.

14. A — sukkar
   سُكَّرٌ is read sukkar and means sugar.

15. C — A group reads a script aloud with expression
   In a reader's theatre learners read a script aloud, using their voices to act.

16. D — جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ
   جِسْمِي قَوِيٌّ (jismii qawiyy) means: My body is strong.

17. A — jabal
   جَبَلٌ is read jabal and means mountain.

18. A — from
   min means 'from', so 'the rain is from the sky'.

19. A — الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ
   الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ (al-kursiyyu ʿinda l-baab) means: The chair is at the door.

20. C — The key is in the cupboard.
   الْمِفْتَاحُ فِي الْخِزَانَةِ (al-miftaahu fii l-khizaana) means: The key is in the cupboard.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Items: kitaab (book), taawila (table). Position words: ʿalaa (on), taHta (under).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word placed correctly.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: And the rain is from the sky.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: I write with my hand. I hear with my ear.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: The fish is delicious.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my body.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: fatHa gives a, kasra gives i, Damma gives u, and sukuun shows no vowel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mark and its meaning.

27. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example bayt (house), ghurfa (room), matbakh (kitchen), hammaam (bathroom), hadiiqa (garden).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Choose a group; share the lines and actions; stand facing the audience; say the poem together with actions; bow at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Words pronounced correctly; smooth reading without stops; heavy and throat sounds clear; no word skipped.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is a party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.
